title: rESP Medication With a Single Intravenous Administration and Dose Escalation to Explore the Tolerability ,Safety and Pharmacokinetic Characteristics
brief_summary: The study is a single center and open test, and the dose of successive incremental method was taken. In order to determine the tolerance and safety after a single intravenous injection of different doses of rESP in healthy subjects, the investigators had this trial. On the other hand, this study is to preliminarily explore the pharmacokinetics in healthy subjects.
